summary: Implemented the approved delivery-repository-integration concrete package/authority/preparation/execution/terminal contract. acceptedMainCommit is always re-read from canonical Git targetMainRef, finalCommit containment and exact Git tree equality are mandatory, and nextDeliveryBase equals acceptedMainCommit. Isolated Git fixtures prove one-final-commit, stale target-main rejection, candidate drift rejection, provider SHA distrust, and ancestry-with-tree-mismatch rejection. No real D04 repository integration or new provider/promotion/candidate subsystem was performed.
